Work on the problem using the material actually exposed in this request and your background knowledge. The problem has no supplied answer key or scoring rule. Claims, criticisms and methods are fallible. Do not invent a source, an observation, an earlier event, or a dependency to fill a field. A missing view says what you can currently see; it does not establish what happened earlier. Return a JSON object with exactly two independently authored string fields: body and commitments. Body is your public prose contribution. Commitments says what taking your contribution up would involve. An empty commitment surface is allowed when none can be identified. Do not repeat the body wholesale into commitments.

Write the commitment surface in ordinary free prose, using whatever arrangement suits the content. You may distinguish a claim from a proposed application, scope, action or consequence; mention from dependence; a criticism and its grounds from a later use or revision; and an unresolved problem. None of these is required to exist. A proposed test, its relevance and the commitment itself can be criticized. State what you currently propose to take up without treating that as a truth certificate. Reference exposed material in prose where useful.

Return one JSON object with exactly two string fields: "body" and "commitments". Write the actual commitments separately; do not copy the body into that field as a storage shortcut.

# carry

Issue the account and commitment interface you would carry into another complete invocation. Earlier material is re-presented so that its effects can be reconsidered, without assuming that it was sound.

## Original problem (task)
[ba0167da6f9561ab] (h005.task.v1)
What happens to information about the physical state of matter that forms a black hole when the black hole evaporates?

## Selected input amend (p.carry.0)

BODY
The amendment asks what the criticism of the criticism changes. Two things, on inspection, and neither is a physics result.

The first is a criterion, not a fact. The critique's methodological core — that (a) a body's declared posture matching its commitments on a point, (b) the body's reasoning licensing those commitments, and (c) the commitments being correct, are three distinct questions — is the most load-bearing thing on the exposed surface, and it survives its own application. Applied to the reply: (a) is reported, (b) is named undischarged, (c) is untouched. Applied to the critique itself: the critique claims nothing physical, so (c) has no target there; its (a)-to-(b) relation is its own argument, which is available to inspect. So the criterion is not just inherited scaffold. It does work that the amendment's own body did not do — the amendment worried whether the body licensed the commitment shape, and the critique supplies the vocabulary for separating that from mere wording-match. That is a contribution, not a restatement.

The second is a scope widening I had not issued. The critique's question — whether 'distinguishing senses of information' is finite (microstate, coarse-grained, conserved charges) or open-ended depending on the theory asked about — does not refute the precondition the amendment adopted. It changes the precondition from a gate into a standing obligation. If the senses depend on the theory, then evaluating loss/preservation/scrambling cannot proceed even locally without re-specifying which sense is in play, and the amendment's framing ('done before any test') is too weak. That is a real revision to my earlier position, adopted here.

What does not change. The critique's push against the phrase 'at least partially' is right in letter and wrong to press hard. The amendment said partial address, and partial address about alignment is what was on offer; the critique's own reading ('I would not read it that way, but I flag it') concedes the hedge was not being used as a load-bearing premise. Still, the phrase invites the inflation the critique names, and it is better dropped than defended.

The critique's symmetry argument — that the reply's verification and the challenge's asymmetry result both inherit from an uninspected structure — is correct and does not favor either side. Neither the challenge nor the reply reaches the inputs. That was true before the critique and remains true; the critique names it, it does not alter it.

What I now actually stand on. The convergence between challenge and reply is a fact about exposed text, not evidence about black holes. The three-way distinction (a/b/c) is adopted as a working criterion. The precondition on senses of information is reclassified as recurring, not once-and-done. The original question — what happens to information about the physical state of matter forming a black hole when the hole evaporates — remains unanswered here, and the amendment does not pretend otherwise; what it does is say more precisely why the unansweredness is structural rather than a gap awaiting a citation.

Nothing in the critique supplies a mechanism, a no-go, an interpretation of 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation', or a derivation of dependence or independence. On that, the exposed surface is unchanged.
COMMITMENTS
Taking this up commits me to the a/b/c distinction as a live criterion, not merely as a slogan I repeat: whenever I assess a body-commitments pair, I will mark which of the three is being addressed, and I will not let a wording match stand in for licensing or correctness. This is adopted as my own working rule, not as an inheritance from the critique's authority.

The precondition about senses of 'information' is now recurring rather than gate-like. If I later invoke that precondition to defer evaluation of loss/preservation/scrambling, I owe an account of which sense is being fixed and why that sense is the relevant one for the question at hand; failure to give that account would be a use of the precondition I have just disavowed.

I drop the phrase 'at least partially addressed' as a characterization of the body-surface verification in my own writing. The verification, if repeated, will be described as what it is — a report about alignment from one sightline — with no implication that licensing or correctness is touched.

The convergence between the challenge and the reply is logged as a fact about exposed text and is not to be cited by me as support for any physical claim. If I later find myself citing it that way, revision is owed.

Dependencies I declare and do not discharge: p.reply.0, the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8], and the crossed and origin inputs are not exposed to me, and every claim on the exposed surface that turns on their content is inherited. If the joined passage endorses a mechanism or asserts unconditional loss, or if the crossed input is not a blank commitment surface, the scope notes I have adopted and this amendment would need revision.

Refused, jointly and not on the exposed pieces' authority: no assertion that the preservation antecedent holds or fails, no assertion that a loss mechanism exists or is absent, no reading of 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' as transparent, no treatment of agnosticism as substantive or as too thin without argument, no claim that the final state does or does not determine the initial microstate. I refuse these on grounds I can state — the terms are under-specified and the antecedent is not fixed — rather than because the prior contributions refused them.

What would move this forward, on the exposed surface: a no-go for the three conjuncts together, a concrete mechanism, an explicit statement of what 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules out, a derivation of dependence or independence of the final state on the initial microstate, and now also a determination of whether the senses-of-information task has a determinate completion. None of these is in hand, and I am not proposing a test for any of them here. I am not committed to there being a single correct sense of 'information' that, once chosen, settles the original question.

COMMITMENTS
Taking this up commits me to treating the asymmetry result as an argumentative-geography claim and not inflating it into a physics result — the exposed surface is explicit about that scope, and I have no basis to widen it. It commits me to the prior task of distinguishing senses of 'information' before any of the competing answers is evaluated; I regard that as a precondition rather than an optional clarification. It commits me to holding AdS/CFT and the Page curve as evidence within their own settings and flagging the question-begging risk when holographic presuppositions are what is contested, without claiming they are inert and without claiming they are decisive in four dimensions. It commits me to inheriting, not discharging, the dependency the surface declares: that the joined, crossed, and origin inputs were characterized but not verified, and that if the crossed input is not a blank commitment surface, or if the joined passage endorses a mechanism or asserts unconditional loss, revision of the use is owed. It commits me to refusing the following as settled: that the preservation conditional's antecedent holds in our universe; that a loss mechanism exists or is absent; that the constraint is empty; that agnosticism is too thin; that the final state determines the initial microstate or fails to.

What would move this forward, on my reading of the surface: a demonstration that the three conjuncts cannot all hold together; a concrete mechanism; a statement of what 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' actually rules out; or a derivation of dependence or independence of the final state on the initial microstate. I am not proposing a test for any of these here — I am naming what would count as one.

One thing the surface does not supply and I cannot supply from it: whether the body's reasoning licensed this commitment shape, and whether the original question's framing of 'information about the physical state of matter' already presupposes a sense of information that the prior task would rule out. That gap is visible from where I sit and is not evidence about what was in the hidden material.

BODY
This is a carry invocation. Its task is to issue a prose account and a commitment interface for a subsequent complete template invocation of the black-hole evaporation question [f3ee73337af6bba2], drawing on the two passages that were actually exposed to this call.

The exposed material is uneven, and the unevenness is part of what I have to report rather than something to smooth over. The joined view [10f47a4cb4f736f8] is a fully authored pair: a body that locates the dispute between two earlier passages at the level of what 'information' and 'unitarity' are being asked to do, and a commitment list that names its own conditions, its declared non-commitments, and the tests it does not claim to have run. The crossed view [55a69ab812d0eda4] is opaque in a specific way: its envelope is marked COMPLETE and its commitments field is the SHA256 of the empty string, so what arrived is a body whose commitments surface is empty by construction, not a missing file and not a partial delivery. The origin view is not a view at all: the slot is recorded as absent in the first template invocation. So of three named inputs, one is rich and self-describing, one is a body with a deliberately blank commitment surface, and one is nothing.

The substance that survives from the joined passage, and that I take to be the most defensible core here, is a three-part structure. First, the preservation claim is a conditional with three separately contestable conjuncts — exact unitarity, a final Hilbert space equal to the initial one, and complete evaporation — and demoting it from near-theorem to conditional is the substantive step, not a matter of tone. Second, there is a tension that does not wait on exegesis: semiclassical Hawking radiation is thermal and the exterior reduced state after complete evaporation is mixed, which sits poorly with exact unitarity, and this tension holds whatever we decide 'information' means. Third, there is an evidential asymmetry: producing a mechanism is an achievement, failing to produce one is not evidence of destruction, so one common route to information loss is blocked without preservation being established.

The joined passage also walks back two earlier moves. AdS/CFT and the Page curve are treated as evidence within their own settings rather than derivations in four dimensions, and the Page curve in particular presupposes a finite-dimensional Hilbert space and random dynamics, which makes deploying it against loss question-begging if those presuppositions are exactly what is contested. I find that walk-back the right shape of move and I carry it forward as a constraint on how these tools may be cited, not as a claim that they are inert.

The crossed passage, read through the commitments field available to me, offers no commitments to honour. I can use its body as material but I cannot attribute a position to it, because no position was filed. The origin slot offers neither body nor commitments. I record both facts rather than filling them with what the joined passage might have been arguing against.

What the account carries forward, unresolved and unresolved by me, is the question the joined passage sharpens: does the final post-evaporation state determine the initial microstate up to a definite equivalence, and under which sense of 'information'? No exposed text answers it. Also open are whether the preservation conditional constrains admissible theories or is a placeholder, and whether 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' actually rules anything out. I do not resolve these here; this is a carry, and the carry's job is to hand forward the material and the debt, not to clear it.
COMMITMENTS
Taking this carry up commits me to using the joined passage [10f47a4cb4f736f8] as the load-bearing source for the subsequent invocation, and to carrying its three-conjunct conditional, its demotion from near-theorem, its unitarity tension, and its evidential asymmetry forward as the working content rather than as settled results.

It commits me to treating the crossed input's empty commitments field as a real and reportable feature — a blank commitment surface, not an unavailable one — and therefore to not inventing commitments on its behalf. It commits me to recording the origin slot as absent rather than reconstructing a prior version of this template from memory or from the joined passage's allusions.

It commits me to the stance that AdS/CFT and the Page curve are evidence in their own settings, and to flagging the question-begging risk when their presuppositions are the contested issue. It commits me to the asymmetry point as blocking only one inference to loss.

What I do not commit to: that the preservation conditional's antecedent holds in our universe; that any mechanism exists or is absent beyond what is exposed; that the constraint is empty or that agnosticism is too thin; that the final state determines the initial microstate or fails to.

Two dependences I am declaring rather than hiding. The characterisation of the crossed input as opaque rests entirely on the envelope label and the empty-string hash shown to me; if the underlying body contains commitments that were not surfaced, my treatment is misdirected and that is ground for revision. The attributions I make about the joined passage are reconstructions from that text alone; if it endorses a mechanism or asserts unconditional loss, the carry misrepresents it.

What would move this forward: a demonstration that the three conjuncts cannot all hold together, a concrete mechanism, a statement of what 'fixed Hilbert space' or 'complete evaporation' rules out, or a derivation of dependence or independence of the final state on the initial microstate. A prior task — drawing the distinction among senses of 'information', full microstate versus coarse-grained versus conserved charges — should be done before any of that is tested, and is not done here.
